verdict.rationale: RingCentral's own docs list an auto attendant among RingEX features, alongside call queues with routing and an AI Receptionist that answers and routes calls, so the core of a phone-menu-to-team setup is claimed. The evidence is only feature-list mentions, with no documentation of building menus or mapping keypresses to teams. Missing for 10: documentation of configuring keypress options (e.g. press 1 for sales), routing menu options to team queues, admin setup workflow detail, and hands-on or independent corroboration.

support.subject: As a support leader, I can build a phone menu (press 1 for sales) that routes callers to teams

citations.quote: The entire suite of RingEX features, including voice, auto attendant, online meetings, team messaging, fax and conferencing are available during the trial.
Call Queues Booster Shorten wait times with better routing, insights, and callbacks.
AI Receptionist Answer and route calls on any phone system.
